result.summary: The home screen of a food delivery app is mostly well laid out. The main visual defect is the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, whose hero image failed to load and shows a broken-image placeholder. There are also a few minor issues with overlapping badges and low contrast.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows a grey box with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo. The image failed to load, so the card looks broken and is less appealing next to the neighbouring pizza card, which has a loaded image.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or loading logic. Add a proper fallback, such as a branded placeholder or skeleton loader, and a retry, so a failed load doesn't show a broken-image icon.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the time badge ('15–25 min') on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps and covers part of the plate image, and it sits close to the left edge. The badge placement looks slightly inconsistent with the image composition.
issues.suggestion: Give the badges consistent padding and position them so they don't cover the main subject of the image.

issues.description: The secondary grey text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', the search placeholder) and the greyed inactive tab labels have relatively low contrast against the white and light-grey backgrounds. The grey heart icon over the grey placeholder is also hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and icon colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for text). Give the favorite button a stronger background or outline.
